Itching for a Creepy Friday! (Spectral Filter)

games.description: A solo alien mystery in a Hungarian town, searching for a missing twin sister. Fuel, village clues and a radio tower lead to the first episode’s ending, followed by its playable preview.
games.title: CHORDOSIS

games.description: A completed solo point-and-click retelling of a strange dream. Sark follows footprints to a grotesque house, explores the roadside branch to its ending, then returns for the alternate path through the rusted tunnel, market and snowy mountain.
games.title: Feet in the Snow

games.description: A solo horror-golf outing that becomes a pursuit through the course. Sark plays the opening holes, fights back against the creatures and pushes through the later forest sections.
games.title: GREENER GRASS AWAITS

games.description: Sark learns the detective tools, pursues procedurally generated murders and earns a living through side jobs. Later visits test Twitch citizens, poisoning cases and a return to the guided investigation; the April sandbox case continues across a stream split.
games.title: Shadows of Doubt

games.description: Sark investigates a facility and follows its spectral-filter instructions. The filter process stalls when the power fails, and increasingly awkward doors and unclear directions bring the visit to an early end.
